annotation.bound_parties_text: The resolution is a non-binding European Parliament resolution that calls on the Commission and Member States but imposes no obligations; it instructs its President to forward it to the Council and the Commission.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Instructs its President to forward this resolution to the Council and the Commission.
annotation.dates_quote: European Parliament resolution of 12 February 2019 on a comprehensive European industrial policy on artificial intelligence and robotics (2018/2088(INI))
